findings.title: Mana buffer is too small for comfortable mine sequences
findings.detail: This export has 306 total Mana, 37 unreserved (12.1%), and 5.4 Mana regeneration per second. Purity of Elements, Skitterbots, and Automation/Detonate Mines are enabled; the main Pyroclast setup is a four-link. PoB's serialized 4.24 Mana/sec and 14 Mana cost belong to its selected Flame Dash calculation, not Pyroclast Mine, so the exact mine sustain cost is not confirmed by this export.
findings.action: First test: turn off Skitterbots while keeping Purity of Elements active, then check a full mine sequence and Flame Dash use. Skitterbots reserves 35% mana; removing it should return about 107 Mana before rounding/modifiers. If still tight, test Automation off and detonate manually; keep the mana flask available.

findings.title: Physical-hit safety still needs work for HCSSF
findings.detail: Current snapshot shows 1059 Life, 440 Armour, 4% estimated physical damage reduction, 1161 physical maximum hit, 26% effective attack block, 0% spell block/suppression, and 0% Chaos Resistance. Total EHP is 2428, but the physical hit limit is the more relevant warning for one-shots.
findings.action: Keep improving life and physical mitigation on gear. Replace normal boots with movement speed, life, and resistances while retaining the Pyroclast four-link.

findings.title: The defensive mastery and fire mine transition are verified
findings.detail: Life Mastery node 12382 still selects +30 maximum Life (effect 47642). Explosive Elements node 61689 is allocated. The four-link is now Pyroclast Mine 3 + Swift Assembly 9 + Trap and Mine Damage 5 + Controlled Destruction 5.
findings.action: The Explosive Elements checkpoint is complete. Test mana before adding more reservation or optional supports; the separate Volatile Mines path remains unallocated.

findings.title: Blast Waves was refunded in this respec
findings.detail: The previous tree had Blast Waves (6233), two Mine Area of Effect nodes, and its travel nodes. They are absent now; the current tree instead allocates the Life/ES bridge and Explosive Elements. Mine Mastery node 59926 now selects 2.5% Life regeneration after a recent mine detonation (effect 6510), replacing the prior Detonate Mines while moving effect.
findings.action: Blast Waves is no longer marked complete. Revisit it later only if its area damage/clear benefit is worth the points after survivability and mana are comfortable.

findings.title: The shield lost block and the chest traded defenses for regeneration
findings.detail: Effective attack block fell from 36% to 26%. The current chest regenerates 23.6 Life/sec but has no explicit Life or resistance modifiers in the export; current elemental values are Fire 74%, Cold 75%, Lightning 75% with resistancePenalty=0.
findings.action: Preserve the strong life regeneration if it feels useful, but seek a chest with life and resistances and a shield with useful life/resists/block when available. Confirm the real Act penalty in game.

findings.title: The new sceptre's added Fire damage applies to Pyroclast
findings.detail: Flaming Faun's Horn adds 24–44 Fire Damage to Spells, plus 6–12 Fire Damage to Spells and Attacks as its implicit. This is a relevant self-found upgrade for Pyroclast Mine.
findings.action: Keep it while it outperforms alternatives; future upgrades can add spell/fire damage or +1 Fire/Spell gems while preserving the shield slot.

findings.title: Normal boots remain a weak defensive slot
findings.detail: Leatherscale Boots are normal with no explicit life, resistance, or movement-speed mods. They hold Automation 2 + Detonate Mines 1 in three linked sockets. Flask set includes three Life Flasks, a Quicksilver, and a curse-removing Grand Mana Flask.
findings.action: Look for movement speed, life, and resistance boots. Keep the mana flask and confirm you can still reserve mana for a safe Flame Dash escape.

findings.title: Act and in-game bandit outcome remain unconfirmed
findings.detail: The export is level 35, sets Alira in Build/Config, and has resistancePenalty=0. The actual Act, bandit quest outcome, and correctness of the configured resistance penalty are not independently confirmed. Ascendancy remains None.
findings.action: Confirm the current Act and bandit reward in game; do not infer Act from level.

findings.title: PoB selected Flame Dash rather than the mine for its summary calculation
findings.detail: The active calculation group in the XML selects Flame Dash. Its 296.17 combined-DPS value and 14 Mana skill cost should not be read as the Pyroclast Mine's damage or sustain cost.
findings.action: Select Pyroclast Mine as the active skill in PoB and export again if you want a reliable mine DPS/cost calculation.
